prompt: A photorealistic top-down photograph, taken looking straight down, of a bamboo Gomoku (five-in-a-row) board resting on a cafe table, its 15x15 grid of lines clearly visible, during the middle-to-late stage of a real game. There are exactly 18 black stones and 17 white stones placed ON THE LINE INTERSECTIONS. The position must be legal and tactically sharp: NEITHER side has five in a row yet, but Black threatens to complete five in a row on the very next move (Black has a four). White's stones form plausible defensive formations. No hands, no stone bowls, no text, no labels, even lighting, every stone clearly visible.
